description:
NativeBoundValue (jobs/native.rs ~4532) and BackendBoundValue (ir_interp/mod.rs ~43) are one enum spelled twice (Absent | Runtime(W) | Transport { shape, lanes: Vec<W> }), as are runtime_lane/runtime_word and transport_tuple_arity (native.rs ~3986 and ir_interp/backend.rs ~3019, inlined a third time at dispatch_exec.rs ~354). TransportInterners::tuple_field_spans (transport.rs ~576) has one caller because World wraps layout_spans and tuple_arity but not it, so native open-codes the destructure; transport.rs ~561 already states that tuple fields and callable captures are both lane sequences, yet native's transport_field_views carries an extra fields parameter only to serve CallableDescr::capture_layouts (native.rs ~4028).

Change: BoundValue<W> in compiler2/transport.rs with type NativeBoundValue = BoundValue<Var> and type BackendBoundValue = BoundValue<AnyValue>; one field_spans(shape) covering Tuple and Callable, wrapped on World; the nine hand-rolled ShapeDescr::Tuple/Callable walks (native.rs ~3051, ~3118, ~4001, ~4027, ~4129; ir_interp/backend.rs ~1807, ~3102, ~3264; the guard half of native.rs ~1074) become calculator calls. Also: lane_form_type_match (backend.rs ~891) decodes all fields to answer a per-position question; decode per position. This is the enabling step for the LaneTest and transport-walk folds. Signal: lib and matrix unchanged; census pins unchanged.

comments.text: Committed 8078f9d4e on fz-gee/fold-arc; draft PR https://github.com/jallum/fz/pull/170 stacked on #169 (stack #171). field_spans yields; field_layouts is the borrowed reading; layout_spans and both transport_tuple_arity wrappers deleted.

title: One BoundValue<W> for both doors and one field_spans(shape) calculator over Tuple and Callable
